description: This file provides a function to extract an audio mode tag from text, supporting inline directives like [[audio_as_voice]] to determine if the audio should be sent as a voice message. It exports the parseAudioTag function.

methods.name: export function parseAudioTag(text?: string): { parseAudioTag
methods.description: Extracts audio mode tag from text using the parseInlineDirectives utility and returns an object indicating the presence of audio as voice, the processed text, and whether the tag was present.
